Name: Bat Dash
Components: V, M (A Flute to Rein in Darkness )
Description:
At the moment one would harm you you instantly dissipate into a cloud of shadows and bats to fly away to safety. As a Reaction to when you would suffer you may transform into a colony of bats, suffering only half of the damage you would take and being able to instantly move toward any direction with a flying speed of 30 feet. As a Bat Colony you do not provoke Opportunity Attacks when you leave a hostile creature’s reach and your AC becomes 8 plus your Spellcasting Modifier plus the Spell Slot Level used for casting this spell.

You revert to your regular form at the end of your next turn or as a free action during your turn, and may use this spell’s Reaction only once, ending the spell after transforming back.
